title: For His Glory
story:
A master artist once painted a grand mural on the wall of a city hall.

It took months of careful work.

Every detail had meaning.

When it was finally completed, people gathered to admire it.

Some said,

“This is beautiful.”

Others said,

“This must have taken great effort.”

But the artist simply said,

“It was never about me.”

“It was about the purpose it was created for.”

In life, people often seek attention and recognition.

They want credit for what they do.

But everything in creation has one ultimate purpose.

To reflect and bring glory to the One who made it.

God is the Creator of all things.

And all things exist because of His will.
life_lesson: Everything exists to bring glory to God, the Creator of all things.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

You alone are worthy of all glory and honor.

Help me to live a life that reflects Your purpose.

Remove pride from my heart.

Teach me to glorify You in all I do.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you live for recognition or for God’s glory?

How can your daily life reflect His purpose?

What areas of pride do you need to surrender today?
verse:
You are worthy, our Lord and God,
to receive glory and honor and power,
for You created all things,
and by Your will they were created and have their being.
